scope: Maintainer-authorized local Home Assistant installation of the uncommitted host-health trial

candidate.source: Working tree custom_components/homeostatic, excluding Python caches

validation.full_local_check: Passed script/check.py in a Linux copy with the same component digest: lint, formatting, strict types, 1730 collected Python cases, both coverage floors and 934 frontend tests.
validation.household_state_rehearsal: A copy of the actual saved settings and stored state restored in isolated HA 2026.9.3 and 2026.10.0, preserved existing settings, added disabled policies and reloaded twice. Notification sending was mocked.
validation.installed_files: All 89 installed component files matched the tested candidate; temporary component staging was removed.
validation.runtime: HA Core 2026.10.0 returned RUNNING; Homeostatic was loaded with no Homeostatic errors in the system log.
validation.preservation: All 24 existing policies and all other settings, including notification sending, matched the pre-install baseline. Four host policies were added disabled.
validation.frontend: Panel v67 and served module v115 assets matched the candidate. The live Policies page showed all four policies off and the low-storage editor showed the missing System Monitor source and candidate limits.
validation.system_monitor: Installed on request; the /config disk-free sensor and CPU, memory and I/O pressure 300-second sensors were enabled and reported numeric readings. Each appeared as an eligible source in its corresponding policy editor. Other System Monitor sensors remained disabled.
validation.live_detection: Untested: the four host policies remained disabled and no sources were selected. No test notifications were sent.

remaining: Explicitly select the relevant sources and enable policies before evaluating live issue detection.
Compare candidate thresholds with representative operation before accepting release defaults.
Run exact-candidate CI and package verification before release.
